en: A colorized illustration of a narrow, old European street lined with multi‑story stone buildings with shuttered windows and arcades at ground level. At the end of the street rises a tall, rectangular medieval tower with a crenellated top. A few small human figures are walking or riding along the otherwise quiet street. There is no visible printed text on the image side.
